title: Medieval, Dalí, and the Mediterranean-iconic!
text:
Met up with our guide Flavia and a full bus worth of folks. We were a mixed group of English and Spanish speaking folks and she did a nice job of addressing both groups during introductory remarks as we would approach the site while on the bus and then again when relaying logistical needs. 
I can appreciate using an app to guide us through Girona as I saw a number of tour groups looking quite frazzled wandering the streets slowly. I felt the app had a lot of good information. title: Na
text: Paulina was amazing!!! If you can see who the guide is beforehand I highly recommend her. Liked the history facts followed by free time.
author: Emily_G

title: A good day
text: Three cities in 11 hours. I was worried that it would be too much, but it works!! We enjoyed all the cities and all were so different. Flavia, our guide, managed a Spanish and English group at the same time on the same bus. She did a great job translating tour information and destination guidance!
author: Catherine_B

title: A Wonderful Day Trip – Girona, Dalí Museum & Cadaqués ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
text:
This was a wonderful day trip combining history, art, and the beautiful seaside town of Cadaqués.

Girona was lovely to explore, especially its authentic medieval charm and historic streets. However, the real highlight for me was definitely the Dalí Museum. I absolutely loved experiencing Dalí’s genius and the uniqueness of the museum itself. It’s not just about looking at the artworks—you really need to pay attention to the surrounding ornaments and objects, and remember to turn around because there are unexpected surprises everywhere! 😄

title: Flavia was Great
text: A really wonderful day. Flavia was an excellent guide. Lots of interesting history and still plenty of time on our own. No one should miss the Dali Museum and the beach.
author: Eric_B

title: Interesting journey with professionals
text: The service was very good and the experience interesting. Our guide Flavia did an excellent job. Very fluent in English and Spanish, covered all the information we needed. Also very calm, polite and supportive. The driver was also professional.
author: EFTHYMIOS_P

title: Loved Girona, Loved the Dali musean and especially loved Cadaques ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text: I loved every minute. Girona is a beautiful place. I would’ve loved more time there, but I also loved the Dali museum and Cadaques. Paulina kept us all informed and on a strict schedule. I loved her humor and amazing knowledge of history. I would definitely recommend this tour ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
